target.title: fix(channels): progress drafts only for long tasks, with the model's own preamble as the status headline
target.body:
Closes #105872

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where Discord (and other progress-mode channels) showed an AI-written "working" status even for tasks that finish in a few seconds. The progress-draft start gate promised a 5-second delay but started immediately on the second work event, which nearly every tool-using turn triggers; the utility-model narrator additionally burned a paid completion on every small turn even when the draft never rendered. Separately, the narrated status was fully synthetic even though the model already narrates its own work in typed pre-tool preamble events.

## Why This Change Was Made

Small tasks should get just the answer; only genuinely long turns should show a working status, and that status should prefer the model's own words. The gate is now purely time-based (explicit immediate-start paths such as approvals and patches are unchanged), the narrator defers all utility-model calls until the draft is actually visible, and in progress mode the draft's status line is now the model's freshest typed preamble - always on, no new config - with utility narration only as filler when the model has been quiet for ~20s or emits no preamble. Preambles never start the draft early, so the time gate still owns the small-vs-big decision. The opt-in `streaming.progress.commentary` lane and its receipt counters are unchanged. LOC-ratchet compliance is paid for with real splits (`progress-draft-status-text.ts`, Telegram `progress-draft-preview.ts`, and small ownership moves) plus lower-only baseline updates.

## User Impact

- Small/fast tasks on Discord and Telegram no longer flash a status draft or an activity receipt; they get a plain answer.
- Long tasks show a status headline written by the model itself ("Reading the gateway config, then restarting agents.") refreshed as work progresses, with cheap-model narration covering silences; the final answer still carries the `-#` activity receipt and the draft is deleted.
- Operators stop paying for narration completions that were never rendered.

## Evidence

- Gate fast-path root cause: `createChannelProgressDraftGate.noteWork()` started on `workEvents > 1` (src/channels/streaming.ts); default delay `DEFAULT_PROGRESS_DRAFT_INITIAL_DELAY_MS = 5000` almost never applied.
- Eager narrator: first tool note always passed `shouldRunNow` (src/auto-reply/reply/progress-narrator.ts) regardless of draft visibility.
- Typed preamble lane (no string inference): embedded commentary normalization and CLI `onCommentaryText` both emit `kind: "preamble"` item events (src/auto-reply/reply/agent-runner-execution.ts).
- Validation on Blacksmith Testbox through Crabbox (leases `tbx_01kxcm7g262wveq2pqqgr1yst5`, `tbx_01kxcrd3xm285wg71xz0sn4kmf`, `tbx_01kxcrwtc2ampzrvvrj5at85c6`): `pnpm test:changed` (auto-reply/discord/telegram/matrix/msteams/slack/compositor/narrator suites green after fixes), `pnpm plugin-sdk:surface:check` green (freshness constant kept off the SDK barrels), `pnpm build` green (plugin-sdk DTS budget respected), LOC ratchet: this branch removes 2 violations vs origin/main and adds 0 (diff proof against stashed clean main on the same box).
- Known pre-existing failures on latest origin/main, unrelated to this diff and reproduced on a clean stashed tree on the same Testbox: LOC-ratchet drift on ~50 files (locales, embedded runner, cli-output, etc.) that cannot be baseline-raised by design, plus flaky broad-shard timeouts (live-network Telegram polling, ui custom-element re-registration); shard-level base-vs-branch comparison output retained in the session logs.
